description.ja: 30 MINUTES LABEL 「30 MINUTES PREFERENCE」よりアニメ「ぼっち・ざ・ろっく！」山田リョウを豊富な付属パーツとともに商品化！
description.en: 30 MINUTES LABEL From the "30 MINUTES PREFERENCE " anime " Bocchi Za Rock!" Ryo Yamada is commercialized with a variety of accessory parts!

description.ja: ■タンポ印刷を施した2種類のフェイスパーツが付属。
description.en: • Two types of face parts with tampo printing are included.

description.ja: ■印刷無しのフェイスパーツと、多数の表情を選択できる水転写式デカールが付属。
description.en: • Comes with unprinted face parts and water transfer decals that allow you to choose from a variety of facial expressions.

description.ja: ■ベース、マイクスタンド、エフェクターに加えてハンドパーツが付属。
description.en: • In addition to the base, microphone stand, and effector, hand parts are included.

description.ja: ■ベースのストラップは資材を採用し、ポージングに合わせてフレキシブルに形を変えることができる。
description.en: • The base strap is made of material and can be flexibly changed to suit the pose.
